source_summary: Blue-green Chinese landscape with misty river valleys, clustered rounded mountains, wooded promontories, pavilions, distant peaks, open water, and foreground rocks/trees. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from the motif bank.

motifs.name: central_peak_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant top-center blue-green mountain massif: stacked rounded peaks rising from mist, with layered contour strokes, dark ink ridges, mineral-blue washes, and small tree clusters along the lower slopes.
must_preserve: arched layered contour linework on each peak
blue-green mineral wash with tan exposed rock transitions
dark ink texture strokes on ridgelines
small black tree silhouettes at the base
soft mist boundary separating the mountain base from the valley

motifs.name: left_misty_island_shore
motifs.description: Isolate the left-side riverbank and island hills: low rounded hills, a tree-lined shore, small sandy spits, and pale water/mist openings around the landforms.
must_preserve: low blue-green hill contours
thin horizontal shoreline strokes
dark pine grove silhouettes along the bank
pale ochre water gaps between islands
soft mist edges around the distant hill bases

motifs.name: right_distant_mountains
motifs.description: Isolate the distant mountains on the upper-right: separate rounded blue-green ranges and pale vertical rock spires emerging through mist, with open atmospheric gaps between them.
must_preserve: rounded contour arcs on the rightmost peaks
faint vertical pale rock spires in the central distance
blue-green wash gradations
soft haze and mist separations between peaks
dark dotted ridge vegetation where visible

motifs.name: middle_wooded_promontory
motifs.description: Isolate the central-left wooded promontory below the main mountains: sloping rocks, dense mixed trees, exposed roots, small tucked roofs, and shoreline forms projecting into the water.
must_preserve: gnarled tree trunks and branching ink lines
dark foliage dots and blue-green leaf washes
rounded rock texture strokes on the slope
small hidden roof geometry among trees
tapering shoreline and pale water edge

motifs.name: ravine_waterfall_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the central-right ravine with two steep cliff faces and a narrow waterfall descending through the gap, surrounded by dark pine clusters and blue-green rock masses.
must_preserve: thin vertical waterfall strokes
dark cliff-edge ink outlines
layered rounded rock texture on both sides of the ravine
dense pine silhouettes flanking the fall
mist-softened base where water meets the lower valley

motifs.name: lower_center_pavilion_spit
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion on the lower central spit of land beside open water, including the low roof, posts, surrounding sparse shrubs, and gently sloping rocky bank.
must_preserve: simple angular pavilion roof geometry
thin support posts
small leafless shrub strokes nearby
low blue-green rocks on the bank
pale water margin around the land spit

motifs.name: right_village_cliff_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the right middle-ground village and cliff cluster: steep blue-green hills, dark woods, nested pavilion roofs, and rock shelves tucked into the slope.
must_preserve: tiered brown rooflines partly hidden by trees
vertical dark tree trunks and dense foliage masses
rounded cliff contours with blue-green washes
small architectural walls and posts
overlapping rock shelves descending toward the lower right

motifs.name: foreground_pines_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground lower-right rocky bank with clustered pines and leafless trees: heavy dark trunks, needle foliage, blue-green shrubs, rounded boulders, and diagonal landforms leading inward.
must_preserve: dark pine trunks and clustered needle masses
fine leafless branch linework
blue-green shrub washes
rounded boulder contour strokes
diagonal foreground slope and layered rock texture

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
